faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Quick answers about buying, renting and listing properties with La Blanca.

zones.q: Which areas does La Blanca cover?
zones.a: We work with properties in Ciudad del Este, Hernandarias and the surrounding Alto Paraná area, including Paraná Country Club, Downtown, Área 1 and Km 8 to Km 10.

currency.q: Which currency are prices shown in?
currency.a: Each property is listed in its original currency, usually US dollars. The currency selector shows an approximate conversion to guaraníes or reais; the final price is the one agreed in the contract.

visit.q: How do I book a visit?
visit.a: On each property page you can send a visit request or message us on WhatsApp. An agent will confirm the day and time with you.

publish.q: How do I list my property for sale or rent?
publish.a: Tap “List my property”, leave your name and WhatsApp, and our team will contact you to assess the property and agree on the terms.

simulator.q: Is the payment simulator a loan offer?
simulator.a: No. It is an estimate using the French amortization system with a reference rate. Actual terms depend on the lender.

foreign.q: Do you work with buyers from Brazil and other countries?
foreign.a: Yes. The site is available in Spanish, Portuguese, English and Guarani, and prices can be shown in dollars, guaraníes or reais. We guide you on the documents needed in each case.

faq.contactText: Message us and we will reply shortly.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains which personal data Inmobiliaria La Blanca collects on this website, what it is used for and how you can exercise your rights.

data.title: What we collect
data.text: Only the data you send us through the forms: name, phone or WhatsApp, email (when provided), your message and the property you are interested in.

use.title: How we use it
use.text: To answer your inquiries, schedule visits, assess owner proposals and, if you subscribed, send you property news. We do not sell or share your data.

analytics.title: Anonymous statistics
analytics.text: We measure visits anonymously, without tracking cookies and without storing your IP address or browser details. We use a temporary identifier that is deleted when you close the tab, and your chosen currency is saved only in your browser.

sharing.title: Who we share it with
sharing.text: Your data is handled by the La Blanca team and by the infrastructure providers that host the site, under a duty of confidentiality.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.text: We keep contact data for as long as we are assisting you and for the time required to meet legal obligations. Anonymous statistics are deleted after 13 months.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can request access, correction or deletion of your data, or stop receiving news, by contacting us through our contact channels.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: For any privacy question, use the contact page or message us on WhatsApp.
